explain: Todo needs no account settings on Vercel. With a database and no operator registration it is a Breakthrough suite app: its origin is its client ID and Vercel's own OIDC token proves it to accounts.royeradames.com, so no client ID, client secret or AUTH_SECRET exists (royer-auth docs/suite-clients.md). Without a database it keeps each list in the browser and says accounts are coming soon. The AUTH_* settings below are only the operator-registered fallback, used for local development against a local issuer.

env.why: Fallback only (local development or an operator-registered client): The issuer origin plus /api/auth (https://accounts.royeradames.com/api/auth). Without it, accounts stay off and Todo says they are coming soon.
env.agentFix: Not needed on Vercel: Todo signs in as a suite app. For local development, put it in .env.local.

env.why: Fallback only (local development or an operator-registered client): Todo's client ID on the issuer, issued for its exact callback and sign-out addresses. Without it, accounts stay off.
env.agentFix: Not needed on Vercel: Todo signs in as a suite app. For local development, put it in .env.local.

env.why: Fallback only (local development or an operator-registered client): Proves Todo to the issuer when it exchanges a sign-in code. Without it, accounts stay off; if it leaks, another app could pose as Todo.
env.agentFix: Not needed on Vercel: Todo signs in as a suite app. For local development, put it in .env.local.

env.why: Fallback only (local development or an operator-registered client): Todo's own key (32+ characters) for signing its session cookies. Without it, accounts stay off; if it leaks, sessions can be forged.
env.agentFix: Not needed on Vercel: Todo signs in as a suite app. For local development, put it in .env.local.

env.why: Fallback only (local development or an operator-registered client): Todo's exact public origin (https://todo-app.royeradames.com). Sign-in refuses requests addressed to any other host.
env.agentFix: Not needed on Vercel: Todo signs in as a suite app. For local development, put it in .env.local.

env.why: Pooled connection to Todo's Production database, which holds each account's principals, sessions and saved list. Without it, accounts stay off.
env.agentFix: Create a separate Free Neon store for Production through the existing Vercel Neon integration (terms already accepted), connect it to Production only, then apply the reviewed migrations with `npm run db:migrate`. The integration manages the value.

env.why: Direct connection used only by the reviewed migration scripts; runtime never reads it.
env.agentFix: Provisioned by the same Neon integration connection as DATABASE_URL.

probes.name: production list answers
probes.ifFails: Check the todo-app.royeradames.com domain on the Vercel project and that Deployment Protection is all_except_custom_domains.

ignore.reason: System variable Vercel sets on every deployment.
